about:
Automotive Parts Associates, Inc. is headquartered in Lenexa, Kansas, with a contact office in Collierville, Tennessee. The company operates as a distributor and buying group for automotive aftermarket parts. No founding year or ownership details are publicly disclosed.

The company focuses on distributing aftermarket automotive and heavy-duty A/C components, including compressor kits and condensers, through its Global Parts Distributors (GPD) line. It also supplies HVAC systems for automotive, heavy-duty, off-road, and agricultural equipment, as well as heat exchange, air and fuel delivery, and engine management sensor products. The organization functions as a network for independent distributors, offering system service kits and a platform for new product ideas.

Its customer base includes automotive repair shops, heavy-duty fleet operators, and agricultural equipment dealers across the United States. The company leverages a nationwide warehouse network to serve the automotive aftermarket, heavy-duty, off-road, and agricultural sectors.

Automotive Parts Associates positions itself as an ally for success, emphasizing collaborative relationships with suppliers and distributors through featured supplier spotlights and industry affiliations.
